messages:
claire: quick heads-up — Vicario week0 private/VPC onboarding. Customer hit a hard blocker when they ran AGIL-3 integration: secrets retrieval failing for model-serving pods, and audit logs show repeated KMS permission denied. can we sync?
alyssa: flagged renewal risk if this drags >48h — they're in PO review next week. low tolerance for unplanned downtime.
mohit: I see the KMS denies in our logs too (errors/2026-03-10T14:02Z). suspect IAM role not bound to node pool service account. setting a quick checkpoint.
ryan: network check: their egress path to our KMS endpoint is through an SG that only allows 443 to build-anchors. nothing else. asked them to add outbound to kms.redwood-internal.example:443 — waiting on their infra team.
jaya: onboarding runbook step 4 mentions `kms:Decrypt` on the node SA and `kms:Encrypt` on the redis-backed cache. did we confirm which SA the installer sets?
claire: they used the terraform module but overrode `node_service_account` to a tenant-managed SA. maybe mismatch. alyssa, can you confirm who owns that override?
alyssa: customer infra lead (sonal@vicario) did it; she pinged this morning and said they wanted to centralize SAs. i'll loop sonal into this thread. @sonal can you confirm the SA name? :point_down:
deploy-bot: deploy event: private-deploy/vicario/installer v1.2.3 applied at 2026-03-10T13:50Z (ok).
mohit: while we wait on SA name, quick mitigation: we can add a short-term grant to the node IAM binding for `roles/redwood.kmsUser` scoped to their node pool with a 24h TTL. manual, but fast. any objections?
ryan: +1 for TTL grant. also noticed VPC firewall rule `vpce-allow-logs` blocks outbound to our audit-collector on port 6514 (tcp/6514). that explains missing audit events. will provide rule snippet.
ryan: ```tf
resource "google_compute_firewall" "allow_audit_collector" {
  name    = "allow-audit-collector"
  network = var.network
  allow {
    protocol = "tcp"
    ports    = ["6514"]
  }
  destination_ranges = ["34.210.0.0/20"]
  direction = "EGRESS"
  priority  = 1000
}
```
jaya: noted. add that to their runbook and run the dry-run. also they need to enable `logSink.vpcFlow` in their org policy for our SIEM ingestion.
claire: security note — security-bot flagged their KMS policy for `principal: *` in one binding; we must not allow wildcard principals. i'll hold on recommending the temporary grant until we get a least-priv role mapping.
security-bot: alert: KMS key policy contains broad binding at 2026-03-09T22:14Z. recommended action: replace `principal: "*"` with service-account-specific binding. severity: medium.
mohit: alternative plan: create a scoped short-lived key wrapper in our account and grant them access via a one-time signed token. reduces blast radius. i'll draft the flow.
alyssa: customer feedback: Sonal said onboarding speed was 'slower than expected' and asked for clearer preflight checks. we should capture that in the post-onboard survey.
claire: agreed. action items summary: 1) Alyssa — confirm SA name with Sonal and post it here (owner: alyssa) 2) Mohit — prototype short-lived key wrapper and TTL grant plan (owner: mohit) 3) Ryan — provide firewall TF snippet and exact destination range for audit collector (owner: ryan) 4) Jaya — update runbook step 4 with explicit SA mapping + audit sink checklist (owner: jaya) 5) Security — validate KMS policy and propose least-priv mapping (owner: security-bot) 6) Claire — draft email for renewal-risk escalation if not cleared in 48h (owner: claire).
jaya: i'll also add a tiny troubleshooting checklist to the runbook: `kubectl describe pod`, `kubectl get secret`, `gcloud kms keys list` and a sample `curl` to the audit endpoint.
mohit: ETA for prototype & temp grant: 3h. i'll post the exact commands and expiry flow here when ready.
ryan: ETA firewall PR: 2h, will include both 6514 and 443 destination rules.
alyssa: Sonal replied in thread DM — SA is `vicario-central-sa@vicario-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com`. putting here for visibility.
claire: perfect. security-bot, can you run the automated policy check on that SA and the KMS key?
security-bot: policy-scan result queued. will post findings in 15m.
claire: thanks team. i'll run the renewal-risk note at 48h if unresolved. pls update thread as you make progress. :white_check_mark:
